name: Standard project agreement
body:
# 1. The parties
This agreement is between {{client}} (“the Client”), represented by {{contact}}, and {{provider}}, {{providerTitle}} (“the Developer”). It takes effect on the date the Client signs it.

# 2. The work
The Developer will design, build and deliver the work described in the Scope section of this proposal:

{{scope}}

Anything not listed there is outside this agreement. Extra work can be added in writing (email is fine), with its own price and timeline agreed before it starts.

# 3. Price and payment
The total price is {{total}}, paid in {{currency}} in line with these milestones:

{{milestones}}

Each milestone is invoiced when it is delivered and is due within 7 days of the invoice. Work on the next milestone starts once the previous one is paid. Prices do not include third-party costs (hosting, domains, paid services or licences), which the Client pays directly or reimburses at cost after approving them.

# 4. Reviews and changes
The Client gets two rounds of revisions on each milestone, requested within 7 days of delivery. A milestone with no feedback within 7 days of delivery counts as accepted. Revisions beyond that, or changes to the agreed scope, are charged separately at a rate agreed in advance.

# 5. What the Client provides
The Client provides the content, brand assets, access and decisions the work depends on, in good time. Delays on the Client’s side move the timeline by the same amount.

# 6. Ownership
Once the Client has paid in full, the Client owns the final deliverables made for this project, including the source code written for it. The Developer keeps ownership of the tools, libraries and general know-how used to build it, and grants the Client a permanent, non-exclusive licence to use them as part of the deliverables. Open-source components stay under their own licences.

The Developer may show the finished work in a portfolio, without any confidential information, unless the Client asks in writing for it not to be shown.

# 7. Confidentiality
Each party keeps the other’s non-public information confidential and uses it only for this project. This continues after the agreement ends.

# 8. Warranty and support
The Developer fixes, at no charge, defects in the delivered work reported within 30 days of the final delivery. This does not cover changes made by anyone else, new features, or problems caused by third-party services.

# 9. Liability
Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential losses. The Developer’s total liability under this agreement is limited to the amount the Client has paid under it.

# 10. Ending the agreement
Either party may end this agreement with 14 days’ written notice. The Client pays for all work done up to the end date, and receives that work once it is paid for. Sections 6, 7 and 9 continue after the agreement ends.

# 11. General
This agreement, with the proposal it is part of, is the whole agreement between the parties on this project. Changes must be in writing and agreed by both. It is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. The parties will first try to settle any dispute by talking it through in good faith.

Both parties agree that signing electronically on this page is as binding as signing on paper.
